sentences.text:
Child Marriage Act (G.R. Case No. 4652 Of ... vs In Re : Aftab
Khan @ Gera on 25 March, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
25.03.2026 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.26 Criminal Miscellaneous
Jurisdiction Ct.No.35 dc.

Not Pressed C.R.M. (M) 86 of 2026 In Re : An Application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 filed in connection with Raina Police Station Case No. 379 of 2023 dated 17.08.2023 arising
out of Cbi, Scb, Kolkata Case No. Rc 0562024S0004 of 2024 dated 16.02.2024 under Sections
363/365/34/368/370/120B/376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3(2)(v) of the
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and under Sections 4/6 of

the
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and under Sections 9/10 of the Protection of Child
Marriage Act (G.R. Case No. 4652 of 2023)

. 
 And
 In Re : Aftab Khan @ Gera
 ...
Petitioner.

Mr. Ayan Basu,
 Mr. Sk. Salim,
 Mr. Sumit Routh
 ...
For the Petitioner.
Mr. Ranabir Roy Chowdhury,
Mr. Siladitya Banerjee
... For the State.

Mr. Amajit De, Spl. Pp.
 ...
For the Cbi.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner intends to withdraw the present bail application and file the application for bail under the relevant provisions of law.
Learned advocates for the State and the CBI are present.
In view of the submissions advanced on behalf of the petitioner, the application for bail being CRM (M) 86 of 2026 is dismissed as not pressed with liberty to file afresh.
